scope: Exposed full-cohort development comparison, all three fixed seeds. Raw probabilities only, no temperature or calibration. The trained encoders are frozen during matched head continuation with fresh optimizers. A pass permits a subsequent prospective study, not novelty, transfer, significance or ICLR readiness. The state-token arm is one added key/value pooling control, not a general prior-state encoder comparison.
